privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: ChipIn uses the information you provide to operate shared-expense and balance tracking features.

account.title: Account information
account.body: We use the account and profile details you provide, such as your display name and email address, to identify your account and show your profile where the product does so.

expenseData.title: Groups and expenses
expenseData.body: The groups, expenses, settlements, and balances you add are used to provide shared-expense tracking and calculate what the app displays.

sessions.title: Authentication and sessions
sessions.body: Authentication and session information is used to sign you in and help keep your account secure.

operations.title: Operating the service
operations.body: Operational and error telemetry helps us operate, secure, and improve ChipIn. Production observability is designed not to intentionally expose sensitive authentication details or sensitive request and response bodies.

updates.title: Updates
updates.body: This information may be updated as the product evolves.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: ChipIn helps you track shared expenses and balances between people.

productUse.title: Using ChipIn
productUse.body: You can use ChipIn to record shared expenses, view balances, and record settlements.

responsibility.title: Your information
responsibility.body: You are responsible for the information you submit and for checking that your records and participants are accurate.

records.title: Application records
records.body: Balances shown by ChipIn are application records for tracking. They are not banking or payment-settlement guarantees.

appropriateUse.title: Appropriate use
appropriateUse.body: Do not misuse the service, interfere with its operation, or submit information you are not allowed to share.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: ChipIn may evolve, and its features or these terms may change as the product develops.

errorBoundary.title: The app ran into a problem

noDebtsDescription: You don't owe anyone and no one owes you.
